name: scribe
description: Writes and audits documentation for an application you built. /scribe:plan surveys the repository and proposes an overview, getting-started tutorial, how-to guides, reference and explanation pages plus a docs layout. /scribe:write writes the pages with every claim anchored to a file:line or a command that was run, then has a reader who knows nothing about the code report where each page loses them. /scribe:audit runs link, anchor, evidence, stale-command, reader and jargon gates over existing docs and returns a ranked punch list.
